description: Three or more sibling blocks of one shape, in line with even gaps, outside list semantics: advisory. A card grid and search results whose titles are headings that link (cards), a column of navigation links, a tag cloud that wraps, pagination and a breadcrumb (links). Not reported: the same cards in a real list, rows of a table and of an ARIA grid, tabs, form rows, paragraphs of prose, short sections under each other that each have a heading of their own, a pair, three blocks placed without alignment, a row of buttons, columns that each hold a real list. Nothing is fail or likely.
